paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.92, with a change of -0.84% from the prior close and -10.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price data is as of August 21, 2026.

Recent news includes statements from Fermi CEO Lee McIntire regarding the Texas governor's data center pause and its impact on Project Matador, as well as the company's receipt of a US subpoena related to the project. Other news includes the appointment of Lee McIntire as interim CEO and construction underway at the Project Matador campus in Texas.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 4 filing on August 18 and a Form 10-Q filing on August 14, which reported a net loss for the second quarter of 2026. Additionally, there was an 8-K filing on August 13 announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as CEO, with an annualized base salary of $750,000 and eligibility for a target annual bonus of up to 100% of his base salary.
